reports.title: TXNM Energy Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

lines: On October 30, 2026, PNM expects to file an application with the NMPRC for approval of a Certificate of Convenience and Necessity for a new 345 kV transmission line, existing station expansions, determination for a new right-of-way, and reconstruction of portions of an existing 115 kV line at an estimated cost of $595 million.
